title: The Lord’s Jewels
old_p1: In Malachi’s day, some people loved and honored the Lord. They often talked together, and they thought about Him.
The Lord listened, and He heard them. A book of remembrance was written for them. A book of remembrance is a book that helps us remember.
Long ago, Adam’s family kept a book of remembrance too.
old_p2: The Lord said, “They shall be mine … my jewels.” Jewels are bright, precious stones that a king keeps safe. The Lord was saying His people are precious to Him.
You are precious to the Lord too. Tonight, think of one thing you love about Jesus, just like those good people who thought about the Lord.
p1: In Malachi's day, some people loved the Lord and talked about Him together. They remembered His goodness, even when others had forgotten. The Lord listened to their words.

A special book of remembrance was written so their faith would not be forgotten. Long before that, families such as Adam's had kept records too. Their stories helped children and grandchildren remember what mattered most.
p2: Then the Lord gave those faithful people a beautiful name. He called them His jewels. Think of a little shining stone kept carefully in a treasure box. The Lord was telling His people how precious they were to Him.

You are one of His precious children too. He knows your name, your hopes, and the good in your heart. Tonight, think of one thing you love about Jesus. Your love for Him is a treasure worth remembering.
note: Levi, 20 Nov 2026 ("Match up the story lantern stories with the published book"): p1 and p2 are the story words AS PRINTED in the published December book (We Have Waited for Him, on Amazon), first and second story page, word for word, so the Lantern, the app's Books page and the book a family bought read the same. The Christian edition reads God for Heavenly Father; p2_christian only where the printed words are Latter-day Saint teaching. The 29 Oct picture-book rewrite is kept as rewrite_p1/rewrite_p2.
rewrite_p1: In Malachi’s day, many people forgot the Lord. But some loved Him. They talked together often, and they thought about Him.
The Lord listened, and He heard every word.
So a book was written for them. It was called a book of remembrance, so they would always be remembered.
rewrite_p2: The Lord said, “They shall be mine... my jewels.” Jewels are bright, precious stones that people keep safe. He would keep His people safe too, like a dad keeps his son.
You are precious to the Lord too. Tonight, talk with your family about something you love about Jesus.
